done_when: plants named after except, excluding, other than, but not or without are removed from the plant set instead of chosen: 'Actual by plant except DUB' covers every granted plant but DUB, 'for DUB excluding CHIR' covers DUB, 'all plants other than H.O' covers all but H.O; leaves for each

findings.body: The added test calls `ChatService` directly through `makeFixture`, which injects `FakeLlm`, `FakeExecutor`, and other fakes (`backend/src/chat/chat.service.test.ts:2998`). Moreover, only `except DUB` reaches that mocked service; `excluding CHIR` and `other than H.O` are exercised only as `questionPlantSet` unit assertions, while `but not` and `without` occur only in the helper-test loop. There are no named tests for each wording through the running API and browser flow with a real database, as required for this user-facing Done-when item. Add end-to-end Ask-flow leaves covering each required exclusion form and asserting the resulting plant-filtered answer.
findings.title: Not done: each exclusion wording has an end-to-end Ask-flow test

why: Ask ignores except and other than and answers for the excluded plant
